wiki.title: Adam Schnelting
wiki.extract: Adam Schnelting (born 1985) is a Republican member of the Missouri Senate. He previously represented the 69th district in the Missouri House of Representatives, which primarily encompasses Harvester, Weldon Spring, and portions of St. Peters and St. Charles in St. Charles County, south of Highway 94. Schnelting was originally elected in November 2018 to serve the 104th district in the Missouri House.
